messages.subject: packrat for project on rstudio server behind proxy
messages.subject_clean: packrat for project on rstudio server behind proxy
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying to add packrat support to my project without success so far. I am using a server machine (ubuntu 14.04) running RStudio Server version and connect to it with my PC. The server and my PC are on the same intranet, which is behind a corporate proxy, thus i configured the proxy for R/RStudio in the server with the following commands:

  Sys.setenv(http_proxy="http://<proxy_ip>:<proxy_port>")
  require(httr)
  set_config(use_proxy(url="<proxy_ip>", port=<proxy_port>))

Also set the required environment variables (in /etc/environment).

To verify proxy setting i have installed one package from CRAN (with install.packages() ) and another (well packrat actually) from GitHub via devtools
devtools::install_github("rstudio/packrat")

Both types of installation worked.

Then I created a simple project from the RStudio Server GUI. I tried by enabling the packrat support from the GUI. Packrat started to configure itself by fetching required packages. As long as it fetched packages from CRAN it succeeded, but when it came to fetch packrat itself (from GitHub), the process stalled. I assume that packrat somehow does not take the proxy settings into account in case of packages fetched from GitHub.

I also tried on my PC with RStudio Desktop version. Here all work fine.

Any suggestion?

BR,
Szabolcs

messages.subject: Re: packrat for project on rstudio server behind proxy
messages.subject_clean: packrat for project on rstudio server behind proxy
messages.body_plain:
Hi Szabolcs,

Packrat uses its own version of install_github (as we wanted to keep packrat as free of dependencies as possible), which at the moment does not support the proxy configurations that e.g. httr does. It's something that we hope to investigate in the next release.

Thanks,
Kevin

messages.subject: packrat:::init() fails in existing project
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am an experienced R user but new to packrat. I have an existing project that I'd like to try managing with packrat, but I'm getting an error.

I open the project using RStudio and type packrat:::init() since I'm already in the proper directory.

R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25) -- "Frisbee Sailing"
Copyright (C) 2013 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

> packrat::init()
Error in hash(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = x)) :
  No DESCRIPTION file at path ''!
In addition: Warning message:
In inferPackageRecord(df) : Couldn't figure out the origin of package caret
>

I need to use the older version of R because the code and analysis I am trying to package were run in that version.

Any idea what this error refers to and how to move forward?

Thanks,
Jeff

messages.subject: Re: packrat:::init() fails in existing project
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jeff,

Thanks for the report -- this looks like a bug in packrat; I'll take a look.

You should be able to side-step the problem by first manually installing caret (into the user library), and then calling packrat::init -- but I will also investigate so that you don't run into this kind of bug in the future.

Thanks,
Kevin

messages.subject: Re: packrat:::init() fails in existing project
messages.body_plain:
Actually, this is a bit odd -- packrat reports that it cannot find the origin of the package `caret`, and presumedly the system.file call is failing because it cannot find `caret` in any of the current `.libPaths()` either.

Can you provide some more details:

1. Do you have `caret` installed, and can it be loaded with a regular `library(caret)` call?
2. What is the output of `.libPaths()`?
3. What is the output of `system.file(package = "caret")`?
4. If the above is not `""`, what is the output of `readLines(system.file("DESCRIPTION", package = "caret"))`?

Thanks,
Kevin
